description: List a room's members as the account sees them in the app: members[], each with user_id (for remove_room_member, set_member_role and member mutes), name, role (owner, admin or member), emoji, colour, picture, personal-room handle and joined_at. In a public room a subscriber who is not staff sees only the staff.
